checkpoint.training: imitation learning from original deterministic physical controller; no PPO updates; fresh network, not transferred hover weights
checkpoint.recurrent_state: zero cell and hidden vectors on EVERY action; returned memory is discarded
checkpoint.inputs: Existing twelve body-frame hover features, then signed world-horizontal heading error divided by pi. No character state.
checkpoint.waypoint_adapter: Replace first three features with inverse_orientation * clamp_length(target - position, 3 metres) / 2 metres. Heading is a separate horizontal unit direction.

selection.selection_rule: Among available five-case passing checkpoints, maximize minimum selection return; ties choose earlier update. No held-out results have been consulted for this candidate.
selection.stop_reason: Selection criteria passed; stopped early for frozen held-out evaluation.
selection.state_mode: zero recurrent memory for every action, in training and inference
selection.qualification_rule: Every case survives all 500 actions, returns at least 400, ends within 0.5 metres, and finishes with at least 100 consecutive actions within 0.5 metres and pi/12 radians of its requested heading.

heading_qualification.criteria: All 128 cases: 500 actions without termination, return >=400, final position error <=0.5 m, and final 100 consecutive actions with error <0.5 m and absolute yaw error <pi/12 radians.

bounded_waypoints.criteria: All 80 cases: 500 actions without termination, final position error <=0.5 m, and final 100 consecutive actions with error <0.5 m and absolute yaw error <pi/12 radians. No hover-return threshold applies to displaced-target travel. Velocity is not part of this target-band counter.

"""Plot recorded native physics without smoothing."""
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

root = Path("runs/quality-research/heading-markov-imitation")
heading = json.loads((root / "held-out.json").read_text())
waypoints = json.loads((root / "bounded-waypoints.json").read_text())
colors = {"north": "#245b9e", "east": "#b85c14", "south": "#13776d", "west": "#84589e"}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4.6), layout="constrained")
for name, color in colors.items():
    episode = next(x for x in heading if x["controller"] == "learned" and x["heading"] == name and x["trace"])
    trace = episode["trace"]
    times = [x["time"] for x in trace]
    axes[0].plot(times, [abs(math.degrees(x["yaw_error_radians"])) for x in trace], color=color, label=name.title())
    axes[1].plot(times, [math.dist(x["position"], [0, 2, 0]) for x in trace], color=color)
    route = next(x for x in waypoints if x["controller"] == "learned" and x["heading"] == name and x["radius"] == 8 and x["seed"] == 0)["trace"]
    axes[2].plot([x["position"][0] for x in route], [x["position"][2] for x in route], color=color)
    targets = {"north": (0, -8), "east": (8, 0), "south": (0, 8), "west": (-8, 0)}
    axes[2].scatter(*targets[name], marker="x", color=color, s=50)
axes[0].set(title="Heading error", xlabel="Time (s)", ylabel="Absolute error (degrees)", xlim=(0, 10), ylim=(0, 180))
axes[0].axhline(15, color="#777777", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
axes[0].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)
axes[1].set(title="Distance from hover point", xlabel="Time (s)", ylabel="Distance (m)", xlim=(0, 10), ylim=(0, 0.5))
axes[2].set(title="Eight-metre moves · 3 m command cap", xlabel="X (m)", ylabel="Z (m)", xlim=(-9, 9), ylim=(9, -9), aspect="equal")
for axis in axes:
    axis.grid(alpha=0.2)
    axis.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle("Native learned flight · frozen checkpoint 200", fontsize=15)
fig.savefig("docs/progress/drone-heading-measurements.png", dpi=120)

plot.meaning: First two panels show one preselected unseen reset seed across four headings; third panel shows four bounded eight-metre routes. These are native physics samples, not browser footage.

selected.selection_rule: Among five-case passing checkpoints, maximize minimum selection return; ties choose earlier update. Held-out seeds have not been consulted.
selected.qualification_rule: Every case must survive all 500 actions, return at least 400, end within 0.5 metres, and finish with at least 100 consecutive actions within 0.5 metres and pi/12 radians of its requested heading.

full_teacher_tilt_priority.result: All 80 cases survived and reached the position/heading target band. Eight-metre cases did not meet the hover-return threshold.

references.scope: Position/attitude decomposition and force/moment dynamics; local Y-up rectangle, reduced tilt error, saturation and gains differ. No stability theorem is claimed for our controller.
Read for tilt priority. No source code copied. Our teacher uses a rotation arc for body up and separate horizontal yaw error.
Motivation for adding labels at states reached by the learner. Our bounded replay and finite update recipe carry no theorem guarantee.

limitations: Browser qualification and integration remain pending.
This is imitation-trained flight, not learned pursuit or search.
No training or evaluation with arena obstacles, moving targets, or failed motors.
The qualified waypoint adapter caps displacement at three metres; direct eight-metre commands failed nine of twenty cases.
Recurrent memory must remain zero on every action; carrying memory is a different, unqualified controller.
The teacher is a deterministic training reference and is not part of candidate inference.
No public library API or playable runtime changed in this checkpoint.
trace_retention: Only traces used by the committed figure are retained here. Every case retains its final metrics; archived source reproduces full local trace files.

reproduction.working_directory: repository root at the recorded base commit or compatible successor
reproduction.procedure: Restore each named source at its restore_path only if absent. Write the stored selection object to selection_file, replacing its checkpoint value with selection_checkpoint_override. Then run the native_gate command. Do not restore the direct waypoint source over the bounded waypoint source: they intentionally share a historical test filename.
reproduction.training: The training source uses its maximum budget of 1000 updates. The retained candidate was selected at update 200 before that budget completed. Its source and teacher are sufficient to reproduce that checkpoint prefix.
